limit_order_match_processing.meaning: a limit order matching (partial or full) is being processed through _processLimitBidOrder or _processLimitAskOrder
limit_order_match_processing.checkpoint: before the zero-cost check during limit order matching

matched_base_amount.meaning: matched base amount of the limit order match
matched_base_amount.checkpoint: before the zero-cost check during limit order matching

matched_quote_amount.meaning: matched quote amount of the limit order match
matched_quote_amount.checkpoint: before the zero-cost check during limit order matching

matched_amounts_bitwise_and.meaning: bitwise AND of matched base amount and matched quote amount (zero iff no overlapping 1-bits)
matched_amounts_bitwise_and.checkpoint: before the zero-cost check during limit order matching

match_rejected_as_zero_cost.meaning: the legitimate limit order match is rejected with a misleading zero-cost trade error
match_rejected_as_zero_cost.checkpoint: at completion of the limit order matching call

assumptions: The zero-cost rejection is the failure mode observed when matched base and quote amounts are both nonzero but their bitwise AND is zero.
Matched base and quote amounts are observable quantities of the match at the point the zero-cost check runs.

unresolved.description: Report does not quote the exact zero-cost check expression; the bitwise-AND-zero encoding of 'no overlapping 1-bits' is a report-grounded restatement of the stated disjoint-bits condition, not a quoted check.
Report does not specify whether matched amounts are caller-supplied inputs or derived from order state.

limitations: The impact's 'misleading error' is encoded as a single observable rejection outcome; the specific error text is not formalized.
Caller identity and authorization for triggering matching are not stated and are not encoded.
